    k(Γ_A) is finite-dimensional #

    graded-category.tex, eq. (2.15) of the proof of Proposition 2.10: "dim C(X, Y) = ∑_n dim J^n(X, Y)/J^{n+1}(X, Y) = dim Hom_A(X, Y). It follows from the finite radical filtration." By Proposition 2.6(3) the Hom spaces of k(Γ_A) are the direct sums of their degree parts, which are the radical layers; these vanish from the nilpotency index of the radical on.
